snippets.snippet_text: "Patreon's payments infrastructure is built to protect and empower creators. Unlike other platforms, Patreon takes on payments complexity and risk so you don't have to. We meet top global standards for safety and compliance so your earnings are protected and hassle-free."
"We handle chargebacks, disputes, and fraud so your payouts stay stable, unlike other platforms that push risk onto you."
"No need to set up Stripe or deal with tax paperwork. We manage all of it behind the scenes so you don't have to."
